name: mandelbrot-interiority
description: An evidence-aware explorer for the interior dynamics of the Mandelbrot set.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:assets
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.poc.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run catalog:check && npm run fixtures:check && npm run test:unit && npm run build:assets
